summary: Learn advanced prompt engineering and AI workflow design with practical templates, evaluation methods, and hands-on labs. Build usable outputs fast.
lede: Advanced prompt engineering helps professionals who already use generative AI structure prompts and design repeatable workflows for business tasks. Training covers context and output controls, prompt decomposition, rubric-based evaluation, and iterative testing, then applies these methods to reusable prompt libraries, workflow mapping, and human-review checkpoints.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already use generative AI and now need stronger control over quality, consistency, and workflow design. It suits people responsible for daily AI-assisted production, review, or automation work across business functions.
prerequisites: Participants should already use one or more generative AI tools at work and have a basic understanding of prompt writing for everyday tasks. No coding is required for completion, but you should be comfortable testing prompts, reviewing outputs critically, and working with digital templates or workflow diagrams. Familiarity with business writing, process documentation, or reporting workflows will help you get more value from the hands-on exercises. If your team uses AI for drafting, research, customer support, analysis, or internal knowledge work, you are ready for this course.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
